mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate, measured by FEDFUNDS relative to its 3-month prior value, reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 250.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising FEDFUNDS rate combined with CPIAUCSL above 250.0 indicates aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts rate, measured by HOUST relative to its 3-month prior value, indicates robust consumer demand for housing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST has risen over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 signals contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) combined with falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong consumer demand but weak supply capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: In high-housing-starts regimes (HOUST > 1200.0), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals cooling in the real estate market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1200.0 and then declines.
